senses.gloss: बहिस् बहिस्, see वहिस्.

बहु बहु, adj., f. हु and ह्वी, comparat. बहु + तर, Utt. Rāmac. 13, 13, and भूयंस्, i. e. बहु + ईयम्स्, superl. भूयिष्ठ, i. e. भूयंस् + थ.
 1. Much, Hit. 82, 5, M.M.; many, Hit. ii. d. 35.
 2. Large, great.
 3. बहुना, with किम्, In short, Vedāntas. in Chr. 219, 10. Comparat.
 I. भूयंस्.
 1. [] More, largest, Utt. Rāmac. 89, 4.
 2. Greater part, Śāk. d. 7.
 3. Stronger, Vikr. 65, 12.
 4. More important, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 6. यस्, acc. sing. n., adv.
 1. Repeatedly.
 2. Again, Pañc. i. d. 184; Vikr. d. 94.
 3. With following अपि, Again, Pañc. 24, 12; anew, Rājat. 5, 296.
 4. Doubled, भूयोभूयस्, Repeatedly, Pañc. 37, 25. भूयसा, instr. sing. n. Generally, Utt. Rāmac. 128, 1.
 II. बहुतर + म्, adv. with following स्तोकम्, More than, Śāk. d. 7. Superl. भूयिष्ठ,
 1. Very rich, Śāk. 3, 11.
 2. Very many.
 3. Almost all, Vikr. d. 8. adv. ˚ठम्, For the greatest part, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 2.
 --Comp.

बाहु बाहु, m. The arm, Vikr. d. 50.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. πῆχυς.

बहुक बहुक, m.
 1. A crab.
 2. The digger of a tank.

बाहुक बाहु + क,
 I. adj. Servile, a servant.
 II. m.
 1. A monkey.
 2. also वाहुक वाहुक, The name of Nala after his change of form, Nal. 15, 2.
बहुकुसुमित बहुकुसुमित, i. e. बहु-कुसुम + इत, adj. Full of blossoms, Vikr. d. 27.
बहुतस् बहु + तस्, adv. From or by much, or many.

बहुतिथ बहु + तिथ, adj., f. थी.
 1. Manifold, manieth.
 2. Very long, Nal. 13, 2.
 3. ˚थम्, adv. A very long time, Chr. 57, 23.
बहुत्र बहु + त्र, adv. In many ways.

बहुत्व बहु + त्व, n.
 1. Multitude, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 997.
 2. Majority, Man. 8, 73.
बहुधनत्व बहु-धन + त्व, n. Wealth, Śāk. 90, 20.

बहुधा बहु + धा, adv.
 1. In many ways, Ṛt. 6, 10.
 2. Manifoldly, Chr. 33, 4; Pañc. iii. d. 74.
बहुपत्नीकृत् बहु-पत्नी-कृ + त्, adj. [] One who marries many wives, Brāhmaṇav. 2, 34.

बहुल बहु + ल,
 I. adj., f. ला, comparat. बंहीयंस्, superl. बंहिष्ठ.
 1. Manifold.
 2. Much, Bhartṛ. 2, 29; numerous, Pañc. ii. d. 8; abundant, Utt. Rāmac. 24, 13; exceeding, ib. 69, 2 (thus to be read).
 3. Abounding in, Man. 4, 60; Hit. i. d. 183, M.M.; Chr. 47, 41.
 4. Variously applicable (a rule).
 5. Black, Ragh. 11, 15.
 II. m.
 1. Agni.
 2. The dark half of a month.
 III. f. ला, pl. The Pleiades.
 IV. n. The sky.

बाहुल बाहुल,
 I. i. e. बहुल + अ, m.
 1. Fire.
 2. The month Kārttika.
 II. i. e. बाहु + ल, n. Mail worn on the arms.

बहुशस् बहु + शस्, adv.
 1. Abundantly, Pañc. iii. d. 183.
 2. Repeatedly, Śāk. d. 22; Vikr. d. 115.
बाह् बाह्, see वाह्.

बाह बाह,
 I. m., and f. हा, The arm.
 II. m. A horse (vb. वह्).
बाहुगुण्य बाहुगुण्य, i. e. बहु-गुण + य, n. Excess, Man. 7, 71 (instr. येन, Exceedingly)
बाहुमय बाहु + मय, adj., f. यी, Made with the arms.
बहु- + माय बहु- + माय, adj. Very wicked, Pañc. i. d. 364.
बाहुल्य बाहुल्य, i. e. बहुल + य, n. Plenty, Hit. 47, 5, M.M.
बाह्य बाह्य, see वाह्य.
बहु- + भौम बहु- + भौम, adj. having many stories.
बहु- + मति बहु- + मति, f. estimation.
बहु- + मध्यग बहु- + मध्यग, adj. belonging to many, Man. 9, 199.
बहु- + मत बहु- + मत, adj. 1. thought much of, respected, Bhartṛ. 2, 59. 2. having many different opinions.
बहु- + मल बहु- + मल, m. lead.
बहु- + मान बहु- + मान, m. reverence, respect, Vikr. d. 2.
बहु- + मूल्य बहु- + मूल्य and महा-, adj. costly.
बहु-स्वर्ण-लक्ष- + मूल्य बहु-स्वर्ण-लक्ष- + मूल्य, adj. worth many hundred. thousand gold coins, Kathās. 22, 97.
बाहु- + लता बाहु- + लता, f. the creeper-like arms, Rājat. 5, 27.
बहु- + वार बहु- + वार, m. pl. many times, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 32.
बहु- + वि बहु- + वि, adj. containing many birds.
बहु- + विध बहु- + विध, adj. various, multiform. ˚धम्, adv. in several directions, up and down, Vikr. 30, 17.
बहु- + शत्रु बहु- + शत्रु, adj. having many enemies, Kathās. 4, 106.
बाहु- + शालिन् बाहु- + शालिन्, m. a proper name.

बहु- + श्रुत बहु- + श्रुत, adj. having learned much, Hit. i. d. 25, M.M. Desider. शुश्रूष, Ātm.
 1. To wish to hear, MBh. 3, 13248; to wish to learn, Bhāg. P. 2, 9, 40.
 2. To obey, Indr. 5, 34.
 3. To attend dutifully, Man. 4, 244.
 4. To serve, Man. 10, 100.
 5. To worship, Rām. 1, 8, 10.
बहु-साधनता बहु-साधनता, f. possessing many expedients, Śiś. 9, 6.
